name: ing.openpick/openpick
title: OpenPick
description: Read-only open source facts: alternatives, repo fact sheets, comparisons and rising boards.

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description: Find open-source alternatives to a commercial product, with license, health and growth facts and source links. Answers come from the OpenPick page for that product; if there is no page yet, the tool lists the products that have one.

product.description: Product name, for example "Notion" or "Google Drive".

tools.name: get_repo
tools.description: Get the OpenPick fact sheet for one open-source repo: stars, change, license in plain words, health, last activity and sources, with the as-of time. Use owner/name or the OpenPick slug.

repo.description: GitHub "owner/name" or the OpenPick slug, for example "obsidianmd/obsidian-releases" or "ollama".

tools.name: get_board
tools.description: Get the current OpenPick Rising (7 day) or Race (24 hour) board: rank, repo, stars, star change and page link, with the as-of time.

tools.name: compare_repos
tools.description: Compare two open-source repos side by side: stars, 7 day change, license, health, page links and the OpenPick compare page, with the as-of time.

tools.name: find_repos_for
tools.description: Find up to 8 tracked open-source repos for a task or product, for example "workflow automation" or "notion alternative". Matches OpenPick names, taglines, alternatives and problem pages. No AI guessing.

task.description: What you need, in a few words.
